steps: Take a free online course on technical documentation (e.g., Google's Technical Writing course).
Practice help-desk scenarios using a free ticketing system like osTicket or Spiceworks.
Learn computer literacy basics: operating systems, file management, and networking fundamentals via YouTube or Coursera.
Explore diagnostic tools like Windows Event Viewer or Linux syslog through hands-on labs.
Start a beginner programming course in Python or JavaScript on Codecademy or freeCodeCamp.
